title: Lovely Light German Potato Casserole
description: A salty, silky, and comforting German dish featuring chili powder, salt-bake potatoes, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, chopped onions, chili powder, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder, and mix well.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the potato mixture for about 10 minutes, or until the potatoes are slightly tender.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the potato mixture in the bottom of the dish.
Sprinkle half of the grated cheddar cheese over the potatoes.
Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining potato mixture, and then the remaining cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
